sources.terrain: USGS 3DEP bare earth, via pspe.simulate.real.anywhere build_domain(source='3dep'); public domain
sources.buildings/addresses/crossings/floodplain: City of Austin open data, ArcGIS FeatureServer
sources.gauges: USGS NWIS instantaneous values; public domain
sources.roads: OpenStreetMap via Overpass, ODbL, fetched at request time

units: City of Austin elevations are US survey feet and are converted to metres here; 3DEP and USGS are metres. City and FEMA elevations are NAVD88.
